records.title: Accident Prone Points on NH-709B
details: a: Government identified 19 nos. of blackspot on NH-709B for which National Highways Authority of India (NAHI) has already engaged agency to rectify the same and work is under progress which is targeted to be completed by March, 2026.

records.title: Unavailability of Essential Fertilizers During Sowing Season
details: (a) to (d): Based on the assessment done by DA&FW, Department of Fertilizers allocates adequate quantities of fertilizers to States by issuing monthly supply plan and continuously monitors the availability position. These supplies are met through indigenous production as well as imports.
